title: The Scarab-Gate of Bangkorai
summary: Hold the timber-valleys and pass-fortresses of Bangkorai when covens of the Fallen Grotto and highland raiders conspire to breach the Bangkorai Garrison and seize the Dwemer foundries of Klathzgar.

npcs.name: Timber-Reeve Hassan
npcs.greet: Look to your harness, traveller! The log-booms on the Lainlyn inlet were cut last night, and cove-pirates raided the sawmill stores.
talk: Lainlyn and Ayasofya sit where Breton timber-wrights and Redguard garrison families share the same wall—and someone is trying to crack that wall from within.
Corsairs from Fallen Grotto stole three wagons of blasting-salts meant for the quarries and hauled them toward Bangkorai Garrison. Speak with Commander Renaud at Viridian Watch.

npcs.name: Commander Renaud of Viridian
npcs.greet: We hold the western timber-line at Viridian Watch, but our scouts just rode in with grim news from the bay.
talk: Tide-Caller Morgana and her cove-pirates have turned Fallen Grotto into a staging-ground, trading stolen blasting-salts to Iron-Chieftain Gharzol in the hills.
Drive Morgana out of Fallen Grotto first, then warn Castellan Suhail at Bangkorai Garrison!

npcs.name: Castellan Suhail
npcs.greet: By Z'en's honest scale, you arrived in the nick of time! A sapper-tunnel was found beneath the eastern bastion an hour ago.
talk: Iron-Chieftain Gharzol used the blasting-salts from Fallen Grotto to breach the Dwemer steam-conduits of Klathzgar, which run directly under Bangkorai Garrison!
Check the supply town of Ayasofya, then enter Klathzgar and stop Gharzol before he collapses the pass wall.

npcs.name: Warden Farida of the Scarab
npcs.greet: The Knights of the Scarab have sworn to keep the pass between high crag and hot sand unbroken.
talk: Gharzol's sappers are piling oil-barrels and Dwemer fire-cores against the foundation piers inside Klathzgar.
Go into Klathzgar and scatter his warband before the fuse is lit!

story_bg_viridian_council: Commander Renaud of Viridian: Look at this powder-keg recovered from the inlet—marked with the Lainlyn timber-seal, but lashed onto a hill-pony pack-frame.
Timber-Reeve Hassan: Sea-pirates in Fallen Grotto and hill-raiders above the pass have never worked together without a shared paymaster.
Commander Renaud of Viridian: Storm Fallen Grotto now and find out what target they are mining!
story_bg_fallen_grotto_parley: Tide-Caller Morgana: You're too late, garrison dog! The blasting-salts are already packed beneath the great wall of Bangkorai!
Commander Renaud of Viridian: Take her head and ride for the Garrison!
story_bg_klathzgar_pier: Iron-Chieftain Gharzol: For three ages this stone gate barred our clans from the timber-valleys! One spark in Klathzgar's boiler, and the wall falls!
Warden Farida of the Scarab: The Garrison stands as long as one blade remains to guard its piers! Strike!

quests.title: Raiders on the Lainlyn Inlet
quests.summary: Report the stolen quarry blasting-salts from Lainlyn to Commander Renaud at Viridian Watch.
intro: Cove-pirates cut the Lainlyn timber-booms and stole three wagons of quarry blasting-salts.
Travel from Lainlyn to Viridian Watch and examine the recovered powder-keg with Commander Renaud.
complete: Commander Renaud traced the stolen blasting-salts to Tide-Caller Morgana in Fallen Grotto.

journal.start: Timber-Reeve Hassan in Lainlyn sent me to Viridian Watch to track the stolen blasting-salts.
journal.done: Commander Renaud pinpointed the pirate staging-ground inside Fallen Grotto.

Examine the recovered powder-keg at Viridian Watch

quests.title: The Cove of the Tide-Caller
quests.summary: Storm Fallen Grotto and defeat Tide-Caller Morgana.
intro: Tide-Caller Morgana and her river-pirates use Fallen Grotto to transfer contraband from the bay to the highland passes.
Enter Fallen Grotto and defeat Tide-Caller Morgana.
complete: Before falling, Morgana boasted that the blasting-salts are already packed in the tunnels beneath Bangkorai Garrison.

journal.start: I must enter Fallen Grotto and defeat Tide-Caller Morgana.
journal.done: I defeated Tide-Caller Morgana and learned that sappers are mining beneath Bangkorai Garrison.

objectives.text: Confront Tide-Caller Morgana in the sea-cavern

stages.objective: Confront Tide-Caller Morgana in the sea-cavern

quests.title: Sappers Beneath the Gate
quests.summary: Warn Castellan Suhail at Bangkorai Garrison and rally Warden Farida in Ayasofya.
intro: Ride swiftly to Bangkorai Garrison to warn Castellan Suhail of the sapper plot, then meet Warden Farida of the Scarab in Ayasofya.
Speak with Castellan Suhail at Bangkorai Garrison and Warden Farida in Ayasofya.
complete: Warden Farida identified the Dwemer steam-gallery of Klathzgar as the chamber directly beneath the Garrison's eastern pier.

journal.start: I must warn Castellan Suhail at Bangkorai Garrison and speak with Warden Farida in Ayasofya.
journal.done: We traced the sapper tunnel into the Dwemer ruins of Klathzgar.

Rally Warden Farida of the Scarab in Ayasofya

quests.title: The Foundation Piers of Klathzgar
quests.summary: Enter the Dwemer halls of Klathzgar, defeat Iron-Chieftain Gharzol before he detonates the boiler, and report to Timber-Reeve Hassan in Lainlyn.
intro: Inside Klathzgar, Iron-Chieftain Gharzol has packed blasting-salts around the main Dwemer steam-boiler beneath Bangkorai Garrison.
Enter Klathzgar, slay Gharzol, and bring word of the saved Garrison back to Timber-Reeve Hassan in Lainlyn.
complete: Iron-Chieftain Gharzol fell before the fuse could reach the boiler, and the great stone wall of Bangkorai Garrison stands unshaken.

journal.start: I must enter Klathzgar, defeat Iron-Chieftain Gharzol, and return to Timber-Reeve Hassan in Lainlyn.
journal.done: I defeated Iron-Chieftain Gharzol in Klathzgar and saved Bangkorai Garrison.
